영문: Hey, Apu, give me a cola and I need another bucket of ice cream with mini pies in them.
What happened to the ice cream with mini pies your wife bought this morning?
I don't knw, I probably ate it, I don't remember things to good.
Thanks for bringing me my model of the disegtion system... hey, where's the gall bladder.
Uh, I got hungry on the way over and it was a fig.
It was modelling clay! By the way dad, mom called, she needs to talk to you before you go to work.
D'oh!
Homie, Lisa left for school without her science project. Can you get it to her?
Oh, do I have to?
You can drop it off on your way to work.
And I have to go to work?!
Uh, remeber that cooler I gave you for your birthday? Well, Flanders wants it back.
Now what'll I use for a toilet?
I'm all in a ditter Homer, so many of my possesions have dissapeared. I called the police to find the culprit.
Culprit, eh.
My lawn mower, my cooler, my lawn chair, a family portrait, even Rod's inhaler, what kind of sick individual would take all of this stuff.
(In his head) Oh no, I borrowed all of Flanders stuff, quick, think of an excuse to get out of here.
Homer, go talk to Ned Flanders, he seems mifted, and PO'ed.
Why me, I'm the worlds greatest neighbor, I even have a mug to that effect.
Flanders, look I found your missing stuff. Now about the reward.
Thanks neighbor-oony. Here's your reward, a prayer from the lord. Dear father in heaven, bless this kind oaf.
Stupid Flanders getting happiness from religion.
Hey, Homer, how about a breakfast churro?
No time, tell me where I can find Mr. Smithers.
I think I saw him  at the Kwik-E-Mart. Oh well, more breakfast churros for Lenny!
I'm gonna need a car with more junk in the trunk if I want to take him out. I wonder if Barney still has the Plow King.
Homie, you're late for work, and todays your workplace evaluation with Mr. Smither.
Ah! He'll find my scorpion farm, then where will my scorpions live!? Only one person can help me, Lenny!
How can I sleep with that camera? Ooh, sexy girls could be watching me on the internet! Stupid cameras, you should be smashed, I'll destroy you at your power source! Hahahaha!!
Oh, so Mr. Burns is behind all this. Spying is so like him that wrinkled old monkey skeleton.
Mr. burns is spying on everybody, we've got to follow him!
Not now Homer, a new violent video game has hit the streets, and we need to get rid of it before it warps any children with its bloops and bleeps!
But that game sounds awesome.
And therefore should be destroyed.
I guess.
C. Montgomery Burns, I know you're guilty accused... Sir.
Fine I admit it, I had a plane shot down. Aunt Hussy was getting to big for her choppers.
No, you're spying on Springfield with your black vans and cameras.
black vans, arent they connected to some pizza concern.
What!? They were only pizza vans. Ohh, I'm a class five idiot.
Smithers, release the hounds, and if this oaf is an employee of the plant, fire him at once.
Hey Homer, you look like you're having one of your trademark adventures.
Danger... Mr. Burns... mini cameras... black vans!
Whoa, good thing I'm drunk!
Stupid drunk, oh no, he's going to warn Burns. I can't believe I'm racing the same guy twice in one day.
I need your truck Homer.
Why should I give you that?
Because I love you.
Hahaha, pay up, sucker!
You're charging your own son?
Yeah, guess I am.
I'm here about fireworks
Oh he** yeah!
One dozen of your best tiowana fire crackers!
I need to get the new Bonestorm or I'll be as uncool as Milhouse.
I'm standing right here Bart.
Hey hey, that's great.
You better get out of here Bart, Prncipal Skinner is looking for everyone who skipped school today. And when you're caught, it's expulsion, Bart, expulsion!!
To late losers, I got the last game! Some crazy lady destroyed all the rest.
Oh when will people learn that video games don't kill people, they just kills there minds.
How am I gonna get that new game?
Who cares? Video games are so late 90s. Illegal fireworks are all the rage now. Better make it snappy though if you want to be apart of this trend.
One box of your finest quality chinese frog loggers.
Here you go, toquilas and chinese sky candies, they'll blow you away!
Sorry Bart, I can't sell booze to a minor, it ain't right.
Ohhh.
Ralph, word in the hood is that you have access to your dad's fireworks stash.
Fireworks make my ears yell!
Here's some gum drops, now make with the works!
My daddy's gonna put you in jail.

I am happy to report that your quest for Bonestorm 2 is quite futile. Proffesor Frink posted a message on my news group, alt.furryanimals.fanfiction.net, that he has bought up all of the remaining games.
I gotta play Bonestorm 2, gimme one!!
Hey, chocolate and fat, you know where I can get a copy of Bonestorm 2?

Yes, I have no time to converse with you, I must be first to register my disgust on the internet regarding the new McBane film. The action was dismal and the nudity was frustratingly fleeting. I barely got going.
Quick, to the fat-mobile, hahaha!!
Yes, I suppose, but must we call it that?
Hey Snake, what's up.
Um, do I know you little dude?
I need that radio you "borrowed".
No way litle dude this radio is gonna help me score bodacious chicks!
uh, last time I checked, chicks liked fast cars not old electronics. Why don't we race for the radio!
Oh i totally agree to your proposal!
Hey, Springfield's lamest, what's the deal?
Didn't you hear? Herman's been robbed, do you know who did it, 'cause if you did, boy that would be great.
Oh no, now where am I gonna get a radio?
These fresh skid marks leading away from the scene of the crime could be a clue but whose to say, really?
Hey there mister slack-jawed yokal!
That be I.
Can i borrow your sattelite dish?
Sure, if you help me scoop up my flat meat, soffisticated city youngster. Those darn revenuers don't like me selling road kill.

You expect me to complete a Mark 10 Truckosorous without a blender. Why don't I just make a Plasma Blade without a tennis racket, for claving sake. Now fetch me a blender with the purey and the frapey and liquidfey.
Now where a I gonna get a blender... oh, Doctor Nick, he loves blending drinks during surgery!
Hi Doctor Nick
Hi everbody
You seem like a heavy drinker, do you have a blender?
Nope, no ok, my monkeys have escaped, can you catch them for me, I'll be so grateful.
Why wont they come back to you.
Because, I have tortured them horribly, silly!
There's no way I'll be able to fit all of those monkeys into my car. I better get a big truck or something.
Well done my little sociopath!
I like to smash
Now my robot will not go on a killing rampage with the screaming and the sadness and the blood on the robot.
Otto, I know I'm a little young to be asking this...
Look, I don't have any special brownies left, I ate them all.
But do you think I can use your school bus.
Oh, right, cool. Meet my price and she's all yours, little lady!
Now to get this inky treasure into its milarch sancuary.
What about my brother, you said you saw him.
I think I saw him at the Noiseland Arcade. Ah videogames, what a waste of money. Now to go online and bid 1000 dollars for an Itchy and Scratchy corn-cob holders. Excellent, excellent buy.
I need to find my stupid brother, have you seen him?

Yes, yes, can't talk now, I must get the last copy of the new Itchy and Scratchy Adventures comic. It's the controversial issue in which they finally kiss! Assist me and I will aid you with your delema.
Oh, this is terrible. A very bad man is delivering road kill to all the Krusty Burgers which are cheaper than my Kwik-E-Dogs!
Proffessor Frink, Proffessor Frink!! My brother, Bart, is missing. Have you seen him?
Well, let's see now, Bart helped me build a monster and then he dissapeared into a bright light.
Wow! This is crazy. I need someone to talk to that is wise and learned.
Grandpa, can you help me find Bart, he's missing.
Maybe I'm just a seanile old man, but Bart's lucky red hat fell out of that black car.
Wow, Grandpa, what a great clue. You showed why senior citizens are valuable members of the community.
I think my baby teeth are growing back, that's why I had to punch that nurse.
I better get something big if I want to take that car out, like that School Bus.
Strike two: running over an elderly person without a license.
Strike one: counterfeit designer jeans, the foulest of crimes.
Excuse me, Chief Wiggum, can you help? I've gotta find my brother.
Uh, sorry little girl, I'm busy collecting evidence on Jailbird. We're busting him on three strikes law.
How many strikes do you have so far?
Uhh, no strikes, but that's only because I'm very, very bad cop. Now, first of all, if you're gonna go undercover, you are gonna need a disguise.
You mean like an eye patch?
Hey, good one, if we could afford a disguise like that, I wouldn't be payed in potato chip coupons.
So, what disguise do you have?
Well, here's one of Ralph's old Holloween costumes.
Fine, wait her so I can get changed.
Milhouse, have you seen Bart or not?!

And strike three, littering. Alright, we got all the evidence we need on this low-life. Now, about your brother. I've seen lots of mysterious goverment types over at the docks. Maybe they sent him on a cruise. They got some good deals these days.
Thanks Chief Wiggum, you are a good cop.
Aw, you're just saying that!
Those poor fish, I mean, sure I'll help.
Argh, thanks for delivering me catch of the day. Now, I can tell ye, I saw your brother.
Really?! That's great.
Aye, he was in a long, black limo and... ahoy, there she drove!
Oh god, I destroyed the limo and killed bart!
Haha, no murder ye be, he got out of the limo and boarded a ship.
Oh thank you, can you take me there?
No, I hate the sea.
Bart, I found you.
(Talks giberish)
Bart, Bart, snap out of it!
(More gibersih)
What's your favorite catch phrase?!
Kiss my grits! (More giberish)
It's no use, his brain is even worse than usual. I'll have to take him home
Chief Wiggum, I need you to find out what happened to Bart. Can you show me where the crop circle is? There's got to be a clue to curing Bart.
Oh, that's cute. I'd love to help, but I have sugar withdraw real bad, the donut shop is closed and I've got a monkey on my back screaming for crawlers. Oh, he's screaming.
Boy for a busy body house wife, you sure get results. That crop cirlce's at Cletus' shack. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a truck load of donuts to eat. I'm gonna need a lot of coffee, hehe.
You've got to help me. I have to find out what happened to my baby boy.
Oh, I'm sorry, I thought you was a city slicker, but I ain't telling you nothing, unless you help us with the harvest.
Harvest? If I'm gonna be doing yard work, I better change or my next "mission" will be to get mud stains out of green yarn.
How can you hooligans steal an old mans medications? You give them back right now!
Oh, we traded them to some dudes in a black car for some PlayDudes. Check it out, man, this one has an interview with the guy who invented the Wa-Wa-Panel.
Hmmm.
Here's your crazy medicine Grandpa.
Hot diggity, sweet medication, gimme, gimme, gimme!!(snore)
Oh great, now I need something to wake him up.
Bart, do you recognize this design?
(Some giberish) That's the alien mind control cola, they gave us tons of that up in the alien spaceship. There using it to make the town go crazy.
Oh thank god, you've snapped out of your trance. I was so worried.
Later, I'm going to the arcade.
This conspiracy goes all the way to the top. I'm gonna need a little extra fire power, as Officer Marge!
Well, I was wondering if you've ever seen a crop circle?
Cool, free deadly cola.
Apu, I think you should be aware that you're selling a tainted cola. Where's this stuff coming from?
Oh, there is little here not tainted in some way. Even the astroligies grow give poor advice. But I will get to the bottom of this.
Well, it made Bart go crazy and if I find the distributer, I'm gonna give them a piece of my mind.
Careful Mrs. Simpsons this cola makes people do errational things without guilt. It's as though they have bottled the effects of a raging frat kegger.
That's it, I'm going after them and any other evil cola trucks I find.
Mr. Homer, sir, do you have a over-sized vehicle that I might be borrowing?
Borrowing, no, selling to you at an insanely high price, yes.
Quickly, cover my incotenent baby's tooshies!
Hello stereo-typical Italian. Pleased to tell me the source of the evil cola.

We don't know nothing... except that the vans are controlled by mysterious strangers. Anyway, you shouldn't snip your nose into other people's business. It could come back to haunt you... and you're family.
Oh my gosh, you're threat has reminded me of my fatherly duties. I'm supposed to pick up the otoplets at the hospital.
I'm afraid we have a medical emergency.
Oh no, my babies!

You're babies are about to go to the bathroom all over my waiting room and diapers aren't covered by your insurance. Ooh, you better hurry, I heard the parents of the Shellbyville 9 are grabbing every diaper in town.
I will get the diapers but there is no way I'll be able to fit them in my car. Maybe Mr. Homer will have a gas-guzzling American vehicle that I can use.
Hello famous, American clown, I wish to ask a favor.
Everyone wants to wet their beacks, uhhh.
I require information about trucks delivering evil cola. How can I get this classified data?
Sorry, Apu, I'm a drink, squeezy, punchy low-life. You need a proffesional scumbag. Follow a cop until you find one. You'll have better luck if ya, you know, look American.
Thank you, horrible man.
Hand over your wallet, dude, this is totally a mugging.
What good luck, a criminal.
Huh?
Well surely a violent, filth bag such as yourself could find out who is driving the black cola vans.
Well, I do have a connection with the DMV but it will cost you. You have to pick up the litter for my community service.
It is a deal.
Deal, now hand over your wallet.
Yes, yes, whatever.
If you do not tell me who operates these vans than I will be forced to use profanity.
Ok, ok, chill, dude. The museum runs them.
The museum? This adventure gets more exciting than the last!
Oh Mr. Bart, I have discovered that the evil cola is being made in the Springfield museum.
But that closes in five minutes!
And my car is out of gas!
Just fill it up at the Kwik-E-Mart.
With those prices, no way!
Fine, we'll take my car.
Hey Kearney, I need to do a lot of collaterall damage in the minimum amount of time.
I've got just the thing. I have a car that was owned by a super villain. He once conquered the East Coast.
Otto man, I need a ride.
No can do, little dude. I gotta round up these other little dudes and get them to KrustLu for the studio tour.
That's where I need to go. Step on it, Otto.
Ok right after I drop these kids off at KrustyLu.
Otto, I just said.
Ok, stop hassling me midget Abraham Lincoln.
Apu, you've got to help me warn Krusty of this alien plot, and thus saving the good people of Springfield.
I'm sorry sir but I cannot speak English, I can only speak Heindi.
But you're speaking English now.
Yes, I learned these words phonetically.
Your just scared about getting vaproized by the space monsters.
Up, down, up, down, go hot dog, button your undershirt, blah, blah, blah.
Barney, where's Krusty? I have to warn him.
Krusty's not here, Little Homer, he's down at the Squidport, doing a promo for this new Buzz Cola.
But that's the cola the aliens are using to control all human behavior.
Control human behavior? No beverage can do that. Oh no, I haven't had a Duff in two hours, my life is over! Ohhhhh!!
But I have to get to Krusty before the limo does.
And I have to stay here and go through the DT's.
Sounds like a plan.
Krusty, listen carefully, aliens are handing out free laser guns and cola that makes you go crazy. It'll be a massacre, the streets will be littered with lasered-off limbs and heads.
Yeah right, and I'm getting into the Country Western Hall of Fame. It just ain't gonna happen, kid.
Oh, I just gotta find evidence. Who do I know that's smart enough to prove this alien conspiracy? Bumblebee Man, Comic Book Guy, Disco Stew, that's it a! A nerd, Proffesor Frink!
Proffesor Frink! You've gotta help me, no one believes my story, it's just just like "The Boy Who Cried Wolf" except, instead of a wolf, it's an alien conspiracy!

Aliens? That would explain the strange transmissions from my Plutonium C-B Radio. I must've intercepted an alien message. It says they're hiding the lasers in the dump truck. Bla, ho, ya, the plot is congriluted now.
Relax, nerd layer, I'll knock the lasers out of the trucks so I can show them to Krusty.
Krusty, I have proof now! See this laser gun?
Principal Skinner, aliens are distributing deadly lasers all over Springfield. We've gotta warn everybody.
All we've gotta do, young man, is get that eliscit goo-god of your hands. Clearly you forgot the the schools zero-tolerance policy of lasers.
Dad, the aliens have taken over the Duff Brewery and they're using it to store laser guns. Ohh, if only I didn't have to do so much explaining.
What, this is Duff's worst disgrace since Duff Ice. It's time to use my secret weapon. Remember when I told you I sold my old car so you could go to college?
Yeah.
It was a lie.
Yay, that's worth more.
Moe, I need your chainsaw to chop up attacking zombies.
Then how will I defend myself?
Moe, Moe, Moe, shouldn't the weapons go to people who have loved ones in their lives.
Yeah maybe your right.
I think I made my point.
Well, I better comb my hair before the zombies get here. (Sigh) my life stinks.
Flanders, give me your first aid kit.
Well I was hoping to save it for Roder and Toder to bandage there brain-eating boo-boos.
Just rub a bible on them.
Will that work to fend off zombies?
Who am I, Doctor Science?
Okely-dokely, here's the first aid.
Daddy, if the zombies are dead, why aren't they in heaven?
Dad! The zombies are on the way, shouldn't we do something?
Not now Lisa, I'm trying to listen to the baseball game.
Oh alright, I'll get some survival supplies. Stupid Brockman getting eaten by zombies.
Hey, you there, Smelly Sam. What's going on?
The alien craft is using some sort of tractor beam to suck up trespassers to their doom. Worst. Effects. Ever.
But that's real.
Worst. Effects. Ever.
What's with the cool black car?

If my knowledge of sci fi movies is correct, which it is, the black car is an advanced probe for the mother ship. Now, if you're through, I'm going to spend my last hours on Earth, complaining about movies on the internet.
The gift of life is wasted on you.
Yes, I recommend you obtain a zombie car. It will protect you well but it is runned on human brains, slight draw back.
I've got plenty of those.
I'm glad you're here my morpobly obbesse ally. Based on my mathulations, I've figured out the aliens weakness. It's nuclear waste. Yuck.
Uh, and how does that effect me?
Well it could save the life of you and your family.
And?

Look, I've loaded my vehicle with nuclear waste from the power plant. I'm going to deliver this toxic payload to the alien ship, risking myself and my delicious brain to zombie snacking which if you've never undergone that, I can tell you it stings.
What a hero, I never knew his name.
Uh, it's Proffesor John Frink.
Are you still here?
I need to buy some nuclear waste, and fast!
Why don't you ask Mr. Burns. His buried nuclear waste has poisoned Springfield for years to come.
Good ol' Mr. Burns. He'll save us! Thank goodness for nuclear waste.
Ooh, is it you Merryweather, come to haunt me again. I kid you once I...
Mr. Burns, it's me, Homer Simpson!
So you're not the ghost of my former partner? Woo, wow, that was... wow.
Look, I need to get some barrels of radioactive waste to save Springfield from the aliens.
I agree, illegal aliens are a nucence.
Not leafblower aliens, tentacle aliens.
Oh, in that case, here's a map to where I burried nuclear barrels all over Springfield. And they said that they made them bleed from the heart. I hope they... bleed from the heart.
Wow, imagine, me getting car jacked. What a total switcharoo.
Just go.
And what will you do if I don't.
Flip you the bird!
Ok, don't get freaky, get in!
Where'd you get that sweet ride.
I bought it with my social security. Thank you Uncle Sucker.
Gimme a lift. I gotta save Springfield.
You're not gonna sacrifice me for the greater good, are you son?
We'll see dad, we'll see.
Ohh.
